notes.title: The official PC version of "Ming Imperial Guards" is now available!
notes.content:
Thank you for your patience and support.  "Ming Imperial Guards" has officially been released at 9:00 on January 19th!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809864/74330c753dedc541c583a633c9a316c279f05e61.png[/img]
To reward your expectations,
[h3]Enjoy a 20% discount on the game's launch special offer[/h3]
The PC version of "Ming Imperial Guards" is a pure single-player buy-to-play game without any in-game purchases.  Unlock it to experience the whole game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809864/05a893799ee6319771304ba15e04aab2818895e3.png[/img]
[u][b]【Recommended configuration】[/b][/u]
Operating System：WINDOWS 11 (64bit)、WINDOWS 10 (64bit)
① CPU: Intel Core i3-4160 及以上
② GPU: Intel HD Graphics 4400 及以上
③ RAM : 2GB 及以上

[u][b]【Sale time】[/b][/u]
January 19, 2024, 9:00 a.m.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809864/05a893799ee6319771304ba15e04aab2818895e3.png[/img]
"The territory of Ming is vast, but there is no extra inch!" In the face of the invasion of the Wara people, Yu Qian shouted before the battle to awaken the soldiers
A battle cannot be lost when a mass of soldiers, with iron horses, defend the majesty of the Ming Dynasty with their lives
This is a story that has been remembered in the long history of the capital defense war, and in the world of the painting of fish, you can become a witness of this battle
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809864/8eaf0f3e2f5a2f6a2d6203deff7c6f50ce61c318.png[/img]

"The stars pull the clouds and the sails rise, the waves tie the sky and the ties grow long" During the Yongnian period, Zheng He made seven voyages to the West.  The legendary treasure drew countless people to go there
Many forces are competing to become the first to discover the treasure, and the reason seems to be more than just for the treasure
Innocent you will be involved in it. Where is the treasure of Zheng He?  Can you get it ahead of others?  The answer will be revealed in the picture of the Ming Imperial Guards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809864/0dad0b241792bfc1bbfdee67dfa12bd6d7aa7394.png[/img]

"When everything may be a lie, where should you go?" National righteousness, family love, friendship, and touching love
A complex emotional web engulfs you, encompassing both truth and lies.  Which are the truths and which are the lies?
....
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809864/05a893799ee6319771304ba15e04aab2818895e3.png[/img]
We hope that you will enjoy the world of the Kim Yu-Tuk and leave the thought that "spending time on Kim Yu-Tuk is worthwhile" as our greatest encouragement!

notes.title: “Ming Imperial Guards”will be officially launched on January 19th
notes.content:
Hello, all the Royal Guards!

Recently, there have been many good news reports from the "Beizhen Fusi".  Today, there is another big piece of good news for you, the royal guards.(✪ω✪)

[h2][u][b]“Ming Imperial Guards”will be officially launched on January 19th[/b][/u][/h2]

We will meet you soon!(▰˘◡˘▰)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809864/8d61100e8144f4a96b4829d34c2a0969dee78beb.png[/img]

In the world of "Ming Imperial Guards", you will be transformed into a royal guard, uncovering the mystery of your own past that has plagued you since childhood, trying to understand the story that took place in the ruined temple years ago, and searching for clues about your lost brother.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809864/f219a1bb03b71954cdc375c90afe27b8fec22a5b.gif[/img]

On the way to search for the truth, he fulfilled the duties of the Royal Guards and pursued the enemy under the orders of the Northern Supervision Department.
Break the mystery of Zheng He's treasure, Persian treasure sword and other mysteries, and catch the real culprit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809864/91f329b607123d32b8c68f44f3b238cdfaf3aa03.gif[/img]

In the face of foreign invasion, we should stick to our beliefs, defend our country, and contribute our own strength to the front line.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809864/1328426481c65bb32a7e4104873ebeb3aefd7d88.gif[/img]

Finally, you will also encounter someone who is particularly important to you, with beautiful lights and a beautiful woman by your side, and you will spend the rest of your life together.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809864/bb410c63b3b4694d900989e50b696a3832fcfa49.gif[/img]

Nearly 100 illustrative videos, a 200,000-word script, and full-flowing voiceovers for the plot... With its sincere content, this game is not to be missed if adults enjoy Ming Dynasty, history, puzzle-solving, plot, and text adventure elements.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809864/05a893799ee6319771304ba15e04aab2818895e3.png[/img]
【制作组寄语】
"Rooted in historical soil, telling good historical stories, history is actually not far away from us. We want to use the way of gamers to let more people understand that period of history. If we can make people a little bit interested, then we have actually achieved our goal."
